title: Delete the 34 group-relative duplicate paths from docs/api/openapi.json (safe to delete on sight)
verdict_evidence: Sampling the TODO's own list of 48 stale paths against the live spec confirms 34/36 sampled entries (e.g. /login, /logout, /books, /me, /sessions, /invites, /{id}, /status) are still present in docs/api/openapi.json's paths object at HEAD — these are documented as group-relative duplicates (the generator missed Gin group prefixes) whose correctly-prefixed twins (/auth/login, /itunes/books, /ai/scans/{id}, etc.) already exist in the spec from the YAML union-merge.

verified_anchors.claim: 34 of 36 sampled stale paths are still present in the live spec
verified_anchors.grep_cmd: python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('docs/api/openapi.json')); print(sum(1 for p in ['/login','/logout','/books','/me','/sessions','/status','/invites'] if p in d['paths']))"

why_tier: Mechanical JSON-path deletion, but requires care not to delete a path that ALSO happens to be a legitimately root-level route (verify each against the real router table before deleting, per the TODO's own caution that this needs 'individual confirmation').
goal: Remove the group-relative duplicate path entries from docs/api/openapi.json's paths object — the ones whose correctly-prefixed twin (e.g. /auth/login for /login) already exists in the spec — after confirming each against the real router table via s.router.Routes(), not by grepping code.
background: The TODO's full list (37 group-relative + torrents + maintenance entries, minus /path and /compare already removed) spans: DELETE /invites/{token}, DELETE /sessions/{id}, DELETE /{id}, GET /books, GET /import-status/{id}, GET /invites, GET /library-status, GET /me, GET /sessions, GET /status, GET /{id}, GET /{id}/results, POST /accept-invite, POST /import, POST /import-status/bulk, POST /invite, POST /login, POST /logout, POST /rebuild, POST /setup, POST /sync, POST /test-connection, POST /test-mapping, POST /validate, POST /write-back, POST /write-back-all, POST /write-back/preview, POST /{id}/apply, POST /{id}/cancel, POST /{id}/deactivate, POST /{id}/reactivate, POST /{id}/reset-password.
steps: 1. Write a small throwaway Go test (or reuse an existing one, e.g. under internal/server) that calls s.router.Routes() on a fully-wired test server and dumps the real route table to a file for comparison — do not trust a static code grep for this, per the TODO's own stated methodology.
2. For each path in the list above, confirm the REAL route table has a correctly-prefixed twin (e.g. /auth/login for /login) and that the bare group-relative form is NOT itself a registered route.
3. Delete each confirmed-duplicate path (and its method entries) from docs/api/openapi.json's `paths` object, preserving valid JSON structure.
4. If a docs/api generation/lint script exists (`grep -rln openapi.json Makefile .github/workflows/`), re-run it to confirm the edited spec still validates.
tests: If an OpenAPI schema-validation CI step exists, re-running it locally is the acceptance check; otherwise validate with a JSON schema linter (`python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('docs/api/openapi.json'))"`, or a proper OpenAPI validator if the repo has one wired in).
acceptance: The 34 confirmed-duplicate paths are absent from docs/api/openapi.json's paths object, and `python3 -c "import json; json.load(open('docs/api/openapi.json'))"` still parses without error.
edge_cases: A route registered through BOTH a direct top-level path AND inside a group (unlikely but possible for back-compat) must not be deleted — this is exactly why step 2 requires checking the REAL route table, not assuming from the list alone.
gate: git diff --check && grep -L 'last-edited: ' $(git diff --name-only origin/main -- '*.md' '*.yml' '*.py' '*.sh') ; echo 'docs/tooling task: header check only'
